scope: Configuration and offline mechanism preparation; no model result or exact numerical reproduction claim.

seed_policy.selection: Select on training validation before independent held-out evaluation; never select on held-out outcomes.

common.output_and_thinking_token_limits: Not set by released reproduction configs; server limits remain unknown.
common.consumer_isolation: A dedicated parent root containing exactly the intended S0 or S1 skill; freeze selected content and rendered prompt hashes.
notes: Do not change author temperature override logic. Record final merged request configuration, not only the input JSON.
Workers=4 is a service-resource deviation and cannot reproduce the paper's 128-worker latency.
Published commit predates paper v5; exact paper-to-commit mapping is not established.
Default verification checks skill format and is distinct from task-level train/held-out validation.

release_readme.basis: Fixed README reproduction command omits --merge-batch-size, so the released CLI default 5 applies.

paper_v5.basis: Paper v5 Appendix A explicitly reports merge batch 32; all other mechanisms retain released native defaults.
